common_rules.time: snapshot.monotonic_ns, in the server process clock
common_rules.scope: Global unless the raw field or Prometheus label identifies a function/generation
common_rules.peaks: Sampled lower bounds at approximately 1s for common/ASYNC and 50ms for short profiles, plus collection cost; not atomic and not exact high-water marks
common_rules.aliases: Reflective paths may point to the same object; never sum aliases
common_rules.missing: Absent fields are unavailable; unselected modules and external runtime populations are not_applicable for this process. Never infer zero.
common_rules.bounds: Effective production configuration is archived inside measured jar application.yml and in each command/function specification. ASYNC retention overrides are in protocol.json.
common_rules.gc: Observed count increase after System.gc; accessors perform existing cache maintenance before GC
common_rules.tests: G labels identify method-level results, not numerical process census values; round-3 provenance separates fresh G1/G6/G10/G14 from inherited unaffected groups
common_rules.round_2: profiles/sdk-* have owner_census per fresh generation; managed/proxy have owner_census unless a gate failed, in which case raw populations remain authoritative. Census includes numeric configuration/cumulative fields as well as populations: do not interpret limits, timestamps, sequence IDs or totals as retained work. Peak/drain can be independently recomputed from populations*.json.gz.
common_rules.wire_unknown: Java-lite/proxy slow body may close or reach client deadline without headers. Admission/refusal explicitly unavailable; offered=1 and completed useful wire bodies=0 are observed. This is not an inferred server refusal.
